name: Target Breach
desc: Attack flow for the 2013 Target breach.

acts.d: Gathered information on Target network configurations
Googled information on Target systems for reconnaissance
Targeted third-party supplier to gain access to Target's internal systems
Attackers may have compromised a default account on the BMC Software Management system to gain further access into Target's network and move laterally
Attackers compromised additional servers using software vulnerabilities
Attackers compromised additional servers using compromised valid accounts
Attackers dropped malware to Target's POS systems
Every seven hours the Trojan malware checks to see if the local time is between the hours of 10 AM and 5 PM
Attackers dropped exfiltration malware onto Target's network
Winxml.dll is sent over a temporary NetBIOS share
A temporary NetBIOS share is established to transfer POS data to an internal dump server
An internal dump server is created to collect POS information from multiple systems via the temporary NetBIOS share

Once data is stored on the internal dump server, an ICMP packet is sent to a remote server (possibly a C2 server) to alert attackers that data is located on the internal dump server and ready for exfiltration
